title: Chapter 424: The Power Of Rules
content:
Chapter 424: The Power Of Rules

The old man drunk said, and the momentum suddenly erupted from his body, like a huge wave, which made both of them rekindled hope.

"Haha, you are full of confidence in the city lord."

Shi Tianzhi shook his head and smiled, but then he also said seriously: "Since that's the case, then we'll prepare to do that gods hard!"

The old man Broken Sword pulled out the broken knife from his waist and slowly stroked it: "Although I am old, the treasure sword is not old."

A few days later.

The outer city of the deserted city ushered in the most lively time in recent years.

All creatures from all races in the Chaos Realm gather here. Some of them come here because of their beliefs, some of them come here because of their resources, and some of them come here because of their reputation.

Some of them are old and calm, while others are young and aggressive, but there is no doubt that they can find their own opportunities in the deserted city.

This is the Huangcheng, a legendary force full of countless impossible forces.

As the geniuses and monsters of all races and the best of the casual cultivators gathered in the deserted city, necessary conflicts broke out one after another.

A large number of deserted guards were dispatched toward the troubled place.

Seeing this, a small number of the indigenous people in the deserted city smiled lightly and quickly retreated.

Most of the remaining creatures looked indifferent and stopped in place with the view of watching the fun.

Rumble!

The momentum of the Huangwei burst out, and some creatures who had no time to give way were rushed out directly.

The huge noise made the people present frightened.

"Say it again, the wasteland guards are doing their business, and the idle people are waiting to get out of the way!"

The leader of the Huang Guard had a cold tone and a rainbow of momentum.

Some of the creatures around him felt this aura and suddenly said in a lost voice: "This aura is a strong man above the Supreme Heaven!"

"What! The captain of a patrol team is actually a strong man above the Supreme Heaven!"

"Is this the foundation of the deserted city?"

"It is worthy of being the legendary holy land."

Everyone said everything, and they didn't dare to be careless and quickly retreated.

As everyone retreated, the two troublemakers in the middle were finally exposed to the sight of the team's wild satellites.

I saw that there were two teenagers.

A young man was dressed simply, with bright eyes, holding a long stick in his hand, staring at the boy opposite him.

The boy opposite was dressed more generously, and he could tell at a glance that he was from a big clan. After he held it with one hand, he looked at the other person coldly.

Seeing that Huang Wei dared to come, the stick-holder quickly saluted the captain Huang Wei, "Master Huang Wei, he was the first to speak rudely to me,"

Before the boy could finish his words, Captain Huang Guard said coldly: "Did I ask you?"

"It's abrupt."

The stick-holder didn't dare to refute, so he had to retreat silently, which made the other boy sneer, and the disdain in his eyes was beyond words.

The captain of the Wilderness Guard looked at the scene. With just a glance, he saw traces of fighting at the scene, all of which were from the hands of these two teenagers.

"According to the rules of the Huangcheng City, fighting is prohibited in the city, and anyone who takes action, regardless of any reason, will be punished."

As he said that, Captain Huang Guard looked at the two of them and said coldly, "Two, come with me."

Hearing this, the stick-holding boy hurriedly said, "Master Huang Wei, he took the initiative first. I am self-defense!"

At this time, a woman also stood among the audience around her. She was in her prime and was very beautiful.

"This adult, the little girl can testify that this young man is indeed self-defense."

As soon as the woman said something, everyone around her felt that the stick-holder boy was so lucky that he would not be dealt with by Huang Wei.

Even the other boy looked ugly and his hands clenched into fists.

But at this moment, the Captain of the Huang Guard sneered: "Practical defense? Sorry, there is no such statement in the Huang City. Anyone who takes action, regardless of any reason, will be punished."

"What!"

The young man holding the stick opened his mouth wide and speechless.

But the woman frowned, "My lord, isn't such a rule not good? If someone attacks death and is going to be beaten to death, can't he fight back?"

The Captain of the Wilderness Guard, who was about to leave, stopped immediately and slowly turned around and looked at the woman.

The woman's face was pale when she was bitten by the terrifying Captain Huang Guard, but as if she was thinking of something, she stopped her steps to retreat and looked at Captain Huang Guard tightly.

The two looked at each other for a moment, and the captain of the Huang Guard suddenly smiled, then pointed at the woman and said loudly: "In the name of Huang Guard, within three breaths, whoever present can kill this woman can enter Huang City forever!"

As soon as these words came out, the audience was shocked.

The woman's face instantly turned from pale to pale, and her legs began to tremble uncontrollably. She couldn't figure out why she was just dissatisfied with this rule, so she would cause death.

But soon, a breath passed.

Some people were already starting to move in the field. Although many people saw that the woman seemed to have extraordinary identity, she was permanently settled in the deserted city, and no creature present could refuse.

Even the stick-holding boy who had a good impression of the woman had a hint of greed when he looked at the woman.

Seeing this, the woman quickly crushed a jade slip in her hand, covering it with a halo, and then she whispered softly: "I am the granddaughter of the Great Elder of the Holy Spirit Clan, who dares to attack me!"

The woman glanced around and tried to persuade everyone to get rid of the murderous intent.

This approach does work, but it only works for those who are not capable of it.

call out!

A black light flashed, and a black shadow suddenly rushed out of the crowd, rushing straight towards the woman.

All this happened in an instant.

Feeling the disintegration of the body-protecting halo and the chill coming from behind, the woman was instantly overwhelmed by the regret in her mind.

Why do I have so many things and why do I have so many words?

Buzz —

And just as the black shadow was about to penetrate him, the space in the field suddenly buzzed.

Rumble!

The terrifying power of rules appeared out of thin air, suppressing the black shadow directly on the spot.

The woman stood there, sweating profusely and gasping for breath. She slowly turned around and saw the black shadow showing her true face. She was a weird man with an ugly and old face.

"Heiyu Real Person!"

Someone here recognized the identity of the weirdo.

The woman quickly retreated and distanced herself from Heiyu Zhenren. She knew that Heiyu Zhenren was the strength of Heavenly Supreme, and was a casual cultivator. She had a grudge against her grandfather and had wandering around for many years.

Her grandfather has led people to chase the other party many times but failed.

This is also the reason why the other party dared to kill him in full view of everyone.

At this time, the Black-Yu Zhenren was staring at the woman and finally sighed: "It's a pity that I was actually taken advantage of."

The captain of the Huang Guard slowly walked from a distance, and seemed to be telling the woman around him, saying, "If you have the power of rules in the Huang City, you can't kill him."

"So, if anyone dares to take action, he must be prepared to be punished."

However, Captain Huang Guard did not punish Heiyu Zhenren, after all, the other party took action and he deliberately led it out.

Seeing the team of deserted guards leaving with the two teenagers, the matter finally came to an end.

As for what the punishment is, they would not think of it.
